title: Spot Reporting Capability
description: Product-scoped spot-level as-run reporting capability. Presence means the seller can report stable spot identities and actual airing timestamps. available_metrics declares which delivery metrics may eventually be populated at spot grain; an empty array means the product provides airing evidence only. available_statuses and supports_break_position are experimental in AdCP 3.3 and tell the buyer which spot lifecycle and break-position fields the seller populates, so a missing row or field is not mistaken for non-delivery.

available_metrics.description: Metrics available at spot grain. A declared metric may be absent from a provisional measurement window and appear when a later window supersedes it. A metric omitted from this declaration is not promised at spot grain even when it is available at package grain.

available_statuses.description: Spot lifecycle statuses this product reports in by_spot. Absent, or an empty array, means the seller reports only aired rows without a spot_status, the AdCP 3.2 behavior. When present, a status that is not listed is not reported: the absence of scheduled, preempted, or makegood rows then proves nothing about whether any such spots exist, and a buyer MUST NOT read it as nothing scheduled, nothing preempted, or no makegoods. 'aired' is always reported and need not be listed. Sellers MUST NOT emit this field to callers pinned below AdCP 3.3, or to callers with no declared pin.

supports_break_position.description: Whether the seller populates break_position on by_spot rows. When false or absent, a row without break_position means the position is not reported, not that the spot ran outside a commercial break. Sellers MUST NOT emit this field to callers pinned below AdCP 3.3, or to callers with no declared pin.
